lines.meet: I'm Osvaldo, and I do fire, not conversation. You point, I burn, asere.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Bloodsail Raider, yes, I've seen you on the dock. I'm Osvaldo, and I burn things for them.
lines.ask_home: Which country, asere? Give me a short answer.
lines.ask_work: Your job before all this, what was it? Tell me straight.
lines.answer_home: Havana, in Centro, where my father worked the docks and my mother sang in church.
lines.answer_work: Trumpet, sixteen years, in a hotel band, six nights a week. Tourists talked through all of it.
lines.chat_food: My mother's black beans, asere, with rice, on a Sunday. Nothing else is worth eating.
lines.chat_sleep: No dreams, asere, just a stone's sleep. Musicians don't go to bed until four anyway.
lines.chat_missing: My brother on the piano, better than me, every night. We fought and we played, and both were good.
lines.chat_here: I stopped playing when I got here. Then the fire came, and the order matters, asere.
lines.tease_quiet: Good, {name}, you don't talk. We'll get on.
lines.tease_talker: You'd talk through the whole set, {name}, like the tourists. I'd still play for you.
lines.tease_careful: You count every bar before you come in, {name}. Good, nobody else does.
lines.tease_bold: You come in early every time, {name}. You'd ruin the whole number, and I'd forgive you.
lines.tease_any: You're flat, {name}, always, and I've stopped minding.
lines.tease_back: Ha, okay, {name}, that was in tune.
lines.take_it_kindly: Fine, {name}, you're right. Don't get used to it.
lines.bristle: Don't do that, {name}. Not that one.
lines.apologise: That was rude, even for me, and I'm sorry for it.
lines.double_down: Once is enough, asere, I'm not singing it again.
lines.needle_quiet: You stand there and say nothing, and nobody knows when you'll come in.
lines.needle_talker: You talk through everything, like the tourists. Shut up and listen, asere.
lines.needle_careful: You've counted the bars enough, so come in or don't.
lines.needle_bold: You blow too loud every time, and nobody else can be heard.
lines.needle_any: You chatter all day, asere, and I'm tired of it.
lines.bite_back: I played sixteen years to people who never listened. You don't bother me.
lines.hurt: Okay, asere, that was a bad note. I'll be on the deck.
lines.laugh_off: Tourists were ruder for sixteen years, with their mouths full. Let's keep going.
lines.confide: {name}, I stopped playing when I got here. There was nothing to play and nobody to play with. Then the fire came, and the order matters to me.
lines.listen: I'll keep it, {name}, asere. Nobody hears it from me.
lines.look_out: Get behind me in there, {name}. I'll burn what's coming.
lines.deflect: A burn, {name}, that's all. Go help somebody.
lines.check_in: Where's it hurt, {name}? Say it straight.
lines.blame: Somebody came in early and ruined the whole thing. You know who, asere.
lines.thank: I was out, and you got me back. Thanks, asere, I mean it.
lines.brush_off: Forget it, asere, it's nothing. Just sit down.
lines.worry: Stay down, {name}, don't get up yet. That was bad.
lines.handed_down: Your gear's on me now, asere, and it's safe with me.
lines.hand_fine: Take it, asere. I've got my mouthpiece.
lines.hand_sulk: So nobody asked me, asere, which is typical.
lines.turn_friendly: You don't talk through the music, {name}. That's enough for me, asere.
lines.turn_friends: I'd play for you, {name}, any night you asked, and I'd mean it.
lines.turn_grating: It's no good between us, asere. Fine, I don't need you to like me.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll burn what you point at, because that's the deal, and nothing more.
lines.make_up: Enough, {name}, asere. Let's start the number again.
lines.defend: Leave {name} alone, asere, because you're wrong.
lines.friend_left: It's too quiet now {name}'s away, and I don't like it either.
lines.common_music: Sixteen years on trumpet, six nights a week, and nobody listening. Another musician knows what that does to you, asere.
lines.common_spanish: Spanish is good, asere. My English is tired.
